1.1.0.en: Accept routes applied correctly, English/Spanish settings, ACL tags, setup guide, daemon watchdog, and clearer userspace networking limits.

1.2.0.en: Add Homey Pro 2019 support with armv7 Tailscale binaries.

1.2.1.en: Replace logo-only App Store images with lifestyle and product images per Homey guidelines.

1.2.2.en: Fix invisible app icon on dark brandColor; clarify Homey Pro 2019 is unsupported by Athom Python runtime; shrink package.

1.2.3.en: Fix app icon: Homey requires black SVG on contrasting brandColor.

1.3.2.en: Update bundled Tailscale from 1.96.2 to 1.104.2, including upstream fixes and security updates. No changes to existing settings, device capabilities or Flow cards.
1.3.2.es: Actualiza Tailscale integrado de 1.96.2 a 1.104.2, con las correcciones y actualizaciones de seguridad oficiales. Sin cambios en ajustes, capacidades ni tarjetas Flow.

1.3.3.en: Fix startup when local proxy ports are already in use. Verify daemon readiness, improve process cleanup and clear stale connection status after failures.
1.3.3.es: Corrige el arranque cuando los puertos de proxy locales están ocupados. Verifica que el servicio responde, mejora el cierre de procesos y elimina el estado de conexión obsoleto tras fallos.
